title: Exact finite D optimization is XP for fixed (d,K)
statement: Because global optima are affine/Voronoi-realizable, arrangement enumeration yields an exact algorithm N^{O(Kd)} for fixed d and K.

proof_location.section: D11. Exact global enumeration for fixed \((d,K)\)

warning: This is XP-style, not an FPT result; hardness and tightness remain open.
